method: built-in image_gen; whole new images; no partial repairs; no API fallback

toolArgs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, cinematic photorealism.
Asset: one single cinematic photographic target image for a spaceflight game, NOT a collage or screenshot. Generate a completely NEW image. The supplied game image is a CAMERA / COMPOSITION reference only, never an edit target, never a source of photographic surface texture.
Visual language: very high-end space cinema, convincing physical materials and light, rich fine detail, dramatic controlled contrast and depth, restrained cool-shadow/warm-light palette, subtle horizontal anamorphic light streaks only when a bright real light motivates them. More beautiful than a documentary photograph, but plausible physical scale and illumination.
Framing: upright PORTRAIT 3:4, same camera location, viewing direction, field of view and normalized object positions as the supplied upright reference. Preserve reference camera; do NOT change to a conventional hero camera. Aim for high-resolution 2064 x 2752 or the largest available native portrait output.
Exclude ALL on-screen interfaces, controls drawn as overlays, typography, map labels, numbers, captions, black caption strip, inset globe, watermarks, logos and flag markings. Reconstruct the real scene beneath overlays. Actual physical spacecraft frames and consoles remain where specified. No readable writing anywhere. Absolutely NO added vignette or arbitrary darkened corners; darkness must come from the physical scene, never post-production corner shading.

Scene: coastal rocket launch pad at true deep NIGHT under artificial floodlights ONLY, prior to ignition. Preserve the elevated downward oblique pad camera: slender upright white rocket at x50%, tip y32%, base y65%; dark launch gantry just behind it, lightning masts and supporting cables around it, pad in lower half, irregular coastline and dark sea to the right and upper right. This camera looks down at land and sea, so do not invent a new eye-level horizon. Unlit land and sea are truly near black, never daylight, twilight or moonlight. Tightly directed white floodlights illuminate the rocket and small wet concrete areas, visible beams in humid air, delicately venting cryogenic tank steam, gantry mostly a dark silhouette, glints reflected in wet concrete. A restrained blue horizontal flare from a bright floodlight. Rocket engines completely OFF, no flame or launch smoke. Keep the reference rocket design and its scale, no writing or emblems.

Scene: rocket ignition at T+1 on the coastal launch pad at NIGHT. The engine exhaust has a dazzling WHITE-HOT compact core, a large bright flame striking the flame trench, dense huge lobed steam and smoke rolling sideways from the trench along the ground; flame illuminates their interior deep warm orange with strong physically motivated falloff. Wet concrete reflects the hot light, rocket and gantry edges lit by the flame. Smoke stays voluminous rather than a flat orange screen. Land and sea elsewhere dark. Fine sparks near the trench only, not a shower across the frame. No writing or branding.

Scene: first instant of orbital sunrise at about 400 km altitude, Earth limb near y38–42% and dark night Earth with broad geographic coast shapes below. A THIN atmospheric arc follows the gentle large-radius Earth curvature, green airglow high above a narrow blue / orange limb. At a single sunrise point near x62%, the SMALL just-emerging sun has a dazzling tiny white core, fine starburst and restrained strongest HORIZONTAL blue/warm anamorphic streak; weak lens ghosts only. Never a huge sun disk or thick glowing Earth stripe. Exposure is pulled down by the sun, so stars and city lights become dim and few, ground still a dark detailed surface. Physically plausible warm grazing light touches the upper/side window rim and console edges; do not fill the cabin with unrelated light. No storm or meteor effects.

Frame and console dark except very weak local reflections. Rich black but spatial detail around the one illuminated cloud.
